dossier.title: Joseph's concluding prayer and the revelation epilogue
dossier.chronology: Genesis predates Islam as a textual tradition; distinguish composition history from extant Hebrew, Greek and Syriac manuscript witnesses. Specific manuscript dates require bibliographic verification.
dossier.comparative_summary: Qur'an 12:101 closes Joseph's speech in prayer and 12:102–105 transitions to revelation, belief, payment and cosmic signs. Genesis 50 ends with Joseph's death and burial instructions, a different literary closure. Genesis 37's conspiracy is recalled in Qur'an 12:102, but its exact wording and transmission need verification.
similarities: Joseph's story is situated within divine providence and his brothers' earlier plot
differences: Qur'an gives Joseph a first-person prayer rather than a death narrative
Qur'an 12:102–105 addresses revelation and its reception, unlike Genesis 50's narrative ending
